shortDescription: Hong Kong's August retail sales jumped 5.6% from a year earlier to HK$32.1 billion ($4.09 billion) for a 16th month of gains, government data showed on Friday.July's retail sales rose 4.5% year on year.($1 = 7.8465 Hong Kong dollars)

children: Hong Kong's August retail sales jumped 5.6% from a year earlier to HK$32.1 billion ($4.09 billion) for a 16th month of gains, government data showed on Friday.
July's retail sales rose 4.5% year on year.
